name: San Juan
type: municipality of Puerto Rico; big city
text: San Juan ( san WHAHN, Spanish: [saŋ ˈxwan]; Spanish for "Saint John") is the capital city and most populous municipality in Puerto Rico, an unincorporated territory and insular area of the United States. San Juan was founded by Spanish imperialists in 1521, who called it Ciudad de Puerto Rico (Spanish for "Rich Port City"). Puerto Rico's capital is the second oldest European-established capital city in the Americas, after Santo Domingo, in the Dominican Republic, founded in 1496, and is the oldest European-established city under United States sovereignty.

credit.text: James Willamor from Raleigh, NC, USA

depictions.name: San Juan
depictions.text: San Juan, located on the southern coast of Cuba, was one of several smuggler dens in the Caribbean. It was found and robbed of its supplies by the pirate Edward Kenway during the early 18th century. Relatively small, San Juan primarily consisted of two caverns, one of which opened up to a cliff overlooking the sea.
